video.title: Indiana Pacers Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

summary: Josh Lloyd previews the Indiana Pacers for the 2026-27 fantasy season. The main question is how Tyrese Haliburton looks after his Achilles tear, because his role affects every other player's value. Lloyd sees Haliburton as a late first or middle second round pick in category leagues, not a top 10 pick, and says he should not go inside the top 20 in Yahoo points leagues. Pascal Siakam is better in points leagues, and Lloyd expects his assists and usage to drop with Haliburton back. Ivica Zubac is his best target if the price is right, but how Rick Carlisle splits minutes between his centers is a concern. Andrew Nembhard is his biggest fade, Aaron Nesmith is a late flier, and Jay Huff is a stash only.
